recommendations: Ali Abbas Jafri “Working with Asad has been one of the most rewarding collaborations I’ve had. He’s sharp, deeply technical, and moves with real founder-level ownership. Whether it’s architecture, product thinking, or execution under pressure, Asad consistently delivers with clarity and intention. He’s building with purpose, not ego and that’s rare. I’d recommend him to any serious team or founder.”

Akash Bhagyawant “It is my pleasure to recommend Asad, who was an integral part of my team at RBC Wealth Management Canada during his tenure as a co-op developer. During his time with us, Asad demonstrated exceptional technical expertise and a strong work ethic. He worked extensively on Salesforce integration and data migration projects, utilizing a wide range of technologies, including Java, Spring Boot, Openshift, Microservices, Kafka, MongoDB, PLSQL and lot more. His ability to quickly grasp complex requirements and deliver effective solutions was truly impressive. Asad’s contributions were critical in ensuring the seamless integration of systems, which significantly enhanced operational efficiency. He also played a key role in migrating large datasets with accuracy and efficiency, showcasing his attention to detail and commitment to quality. Beyond his technical skills, Asad was a team player who collaborated effectively with stakeholders across various functions. His proactive communication and problem-solving skills fostered a positive and productive working environment. I have no doubt that Asad will excel in any role he undertakes. He is a highly capable developer with a passion for innovation and a proven ability to deliver results.”

projects.title: Android Assist
projects.description: Motivated by the work at @CultureLink.ca and inspired by Apple's Assistive Access, we set out on a mission to enhance the accessibility of Android devices for seniors. Rather than expecting seniors to adapt to technology, we recognized the importance of making technology adapt to them. Thus, we developed Android Assist with the aim of simplifying smartphone usage for senior citizens, ensuring they can effortlessly navigate and utilize their devices. Our goal was to bridge the digital divide and empower seniors to stay connected, informed, and engaged in today's increasingly digital world.Git: https://github.com/asadCoder/Android-Assist

projects.title: Signify
projects.description: The current communication gap between deaf and hearing individuals due to the lack of access to sign language interpretation services creates exclusion and isolation of the deaf community. This issue results in a lack of access to essential services, information and opportunities, as well as social and economic disadvantages for the deaf community.Our app aims to address this issue by providing a real-time solution that detects sign language gestures, translates them into written text, and facilitates communication between deaf and hearing individuals, breaking down communication barriers and creating a more inclusive world.Impact:Improved communication: The app enables deaf individuals to communicate more effectively with those who can hear, breaking down communication barriers and allowing for more seamless communication.Increased access to information: The app allows deaf individuals to access information that was previously unavailable to them due to the language barrier. This includes accessing educational materials, job opportunities, and social and cultural events.Enhanced social inclusion: The app promotes social inclusion by allowing deaf individuals to fully participate in society and interact with their hearing peers.

projects.title: Health Canada App
projects.description: By assessing our own needs and thinking about needs of the greater Canadian population, we have created the start of a vision of a more advanced and inclusive healthcare system. Our app aims to increase efficiency, promote equity and inclusion in the health care industry by creating a platform where everyone has an equal chance of accessing healthcare services quickly and effectively.The (prototype) app supports multiple functionalities: it allows the storage and monitoring of medical information, empowers individuals with accessibility needs by making it easier to book appointments through our app, view results from testing etc. Moreover, with all these features combined, our app also aims to to reduce clinic and hospital wait times.
